move: tap squashes heart, it fills red and elastic-pops with ring bloom and particle burst
how: A large outlined heart sits centred on white with a likes counter beneath. The heart scales in from 0.7 with back.out(2) in the first 17% of the 3s loop. At 0.75s (25%) a grey tap circle expands and fades while the heart squashes to 0.7 with power2.in; at 0.89s the path fills red and the heart springs to 1.25 with elastic.out(1.2,0.45) then eases to 1; a red ring blooms scale 0 to 1.9 while its borderWidth thins 40 to 2 with power3.out, and 14 coloured dots scatter to 150 to 230px on evenly spaced seeded angles with power3.out then shrink away. The counter rolls 1,204 to 1,205 with back.out(1.6). At 2.35s (78%) a second tap unlikes: heart dips 0.85, the fill returns to transparent with a black stroke, back.out(2) restores scale and the counter rolls back.
adapt: Change the heart path or icon, the red, the five particle colours, the counter values and N; keep the 0.14s squash then elastic.out(1.2,0.45) pop and the ring borderWidth 40 to 2 bloom.
port: mount(el, shot) builds wrap (ring, N particles seeded with fx.rng, heart svg, tap circle) and counter column inside el. animate returns the timeline with tap at 0.25D, pop 0.297D, particles 0.3D to 0.52D, counter 0.333D, unlike 0.783D. The initial from() tweens need immediateRender:false; scope selectors to el.
caveats: heart and counter enter with from() and stay visible, so the loop restarts with an entry pop
